name: core
description: Framework + operator interface (required by all packs)

name: learning_deepdive
description: Spaced repetition game + codebase knowledge search

name: research
description: Web scraping, feeds, policy tracking, job search

name: development
description: Local development setup with library repos and volume mounts (edit code live)

name: developer-github
description: GitHub integration (webhook receiver + API queries for PR/issue context)

name: webhook
description: Webhook infrastructure (ngrok tunneling for local dev webhooks - works with Discord, GitHub, etc.)

name: auditor
description: Self-service operability audit platform (scaffolds boot + register; measurement methodology lands with the implementation phase). Design: vagrant-test/AUDITOR_PACK_DESIGN.md - the 3 remaining critical methodology bots (documentation_validator, code_alignment, phase_comparator) join when their repos exist.

name: sre
description: SRE observer bot (sre) — audit/pod/alert/investigation/runbook intake, incident coordination; the staging fleet's judge for behavior tests

name: conformance
description: Conformance bot (conformance) — the fleet integration test bot: registry-driven cross-bot probe suite; publishes result envelopes + sre audit receipts + failure incidents so sre can validate that integration paths light up

name: auditor_scan
description: Auditor checklist runner (repo_scanner) — runs the bot-contract checklist against the fleet's own bot repos; publishes sre audit receipts. Stage-only subset of the auditor pack (the other auditor bots are unimplemented scaffolds).
